transcript: Speaker A: So I just found this dev tool that wrote my entire Slack update without me having to type anything on my keyboard. Check this out. Hey team, just a heads up, the session persistence bug is fixed. Pushed the patch about 10 minutes ago. Wait, actually I pushed the patch this morning. Should be good to test in staging now. Let me know if you run into any weird issues. Smiley face emoji. So the tool removes all my filler words and it even fixed that sentence that I messed up. So the tool is called Wispr Flow and you can actually try it for free today.
on_screen_text: This dev tool makes Slack updates easy. Try it for FREE today.
summary: A developer demonstrates Wispr Flow, an AI dictation tool that formats spoken updates for Slack by removing filler words and correcting mistakes. He shows a live demo of dictating a status update and invites viewers to try the tool for free.
